zh.title: 長榮航空力推減碳 第6屆供應商大會聚焦4大面向
zh.summary: 長榮航空舉辦供應商大會；逾130名夥伴與會；聚焦4大減碳面向
body: 長榮航空今天在張榮發基金會國際會議中心舉辦第6屆供應商大會，邀集國內外77家供應商代表，逾130名產業夥伴齊聚。這次大會以「企業韌性與永續管理」為主軸，聚焦環境保護、經濟效益與社會責任。
長榮航空表示，自2021年起已連6年舉辦供應商大會，今年邀請BSI英國標準協會顧問蒲樹盛，以「航空業韌性、淨零與AI轉型」為題進行專題演講，分享航空產業面對地緣政治衝擊、碳法遵及數位營運等挑戰下的整合策略。
長榮航空指出，今年的綠色供應鏈計畫聚焦綠能節電、綠色循環、綠色能源及綠色運輸4大面向，並針對參與長榮航空2025年綠色供應鏈計畫的獲獎供應商進行頒獎，肯定供應商推動節能減碳與永續轉型的成果。

en.title: EVA Air holds 6th supplier conference to accelerate supply-chain decarbonization
en.summary: EVA Air holds 6th supplier day; over 130 suppliers attend; decarb focus
body: EVA Air held its 6th supplier conference at the Chang Yung-fa Foundation International Convention Center on Tuesday, gathering over 130 industry partners from 77 domestic and foreign suppliers. The event centered on the theme "Corporate Resilience and Green Management."

The airline said it has hosted the supplier conference for six consecutive years since 2021. BSI Taiwan consultant Pu Shu-sheng delivered a keynote speech titled "Aviation Industry Resilience, Net Zero and AI Transformation."

EVA Air said this year's green supply chain program focuses on green energy saving, circular economy, renewable energy and green transport, and honored suppliers participating in its 2025 program for their achievements in energy savings, carbon reduction and sustainability.
